usedFor: Fathom captures your meetings and HubSpot holds the contact, so “New Action Item” can feed “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Action Item” in Fathom, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A meeting follow-up is written onto the contact record, so the next person sees what was agreed.

watchOut: “Update Contact” finds the contact by email, so it needs an email and an existing HubSpot contact.
